relations.quote: The group is handled by the network of [Binary phase frames](phase-frames.md), with $W$ wires and $s$ smaller calls.

The cost of the layer follows the recursion of [Recursive power saving](rank-recurrence.md): since $s<Wm$, $s/W\le m^\sigma$ for a fixed $\sigma<1$, so each factor $m$ in $e$ multiplies the cost per unit volume by at most $m^\sigma$, not $m$.

The layer performs each row addition by [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md), which XORs them with a third chunk as restored scratch, by eight cyclic shifts of whole chunk ranges plus a repair of a bounded set of exceptional addresses.
The layer is evaluated in [Fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md).

symbols.meaning: A bound on the number of arithmetic operations on a chain from an input coefficient to an intermediate one.
